import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;
    static long n, k;
    static List<Mat> baseM, invM;
    static List<List<Mat>> expE, invE;
    static Vec current;

    static class Vec {
        long[] a;

        Vec(int size) {
            a = new long[size];
            Arrays.fill(a, 0);
        }
    }

    static class Mat {
        long[][] a;

        Mat(int size) {
            a = new long[size][size];
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                Arrays.fill(a[i], 0);
            }
        }
    }

    static int digit_sum_mod(long x) {
        if (x < k) return (int) x;
        return (int) ((x + digit_sum_mod(x / k)) % k);
    }

    static Mat multiply(Mat A, Mat B) {
        int size = A.a.length;
        Mat C = new Mat(size);
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
                C.a[i][j] = 0;
                for (int p = 0; p < size; p++) {
                    C.a[i][j] = (C.a[i][j] + (A.a[i][p] % MOD) * (B.a[p][j] % MOD)) % MOD;
                }
                C.a[i][j] = (C.a[i][j] % MOD + MOD) % MOD;
            }
        }
        return C;
    }

    static Vec multiply(Mat A, Vec v) {
        int size = A.a.length;
        Vec res = new Vec(size);
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            res.a[i] = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
                res.a[i] = (res.a[i] + (v.a[j] % MOD) * (A.a[i][j] % MOD)) % MOD;
            }
            res.a[i] = (res.a[i] % MOD + MOD) % MOD;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static void preprocess() {
        int size = (int) k;
        expE = new ArrayList<>();
        invE = new ArrayList<>();
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 200; i++) {
            List<Mat> levelExp = new ArrayList<>();
            List<Mat> levelInv = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int j = 0; j < 40; j++) {
                levelExp.add(new Mat(size));
                levelInv.add(new Mat(size));
            }
            expE.add(levelExp);
            invE.add(levelInv);
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            expE.get(0).set(i, baseM.get(i));
            invE.get(0).set(i, invM.get(i));
        }
        
        int depth = 0;
        long temp = n;
        while (temp > 0) {
            ++depth;
            temp /= k;
        }
        
        for (int level = 1; level <= depth; level++) {
            expE.get(level).set(0, expE.get(level - 1).get(0));
            invE.get(level).set(0, invE.get(level - 1).get(0));
            
            for (int idx = 1; idx < k; idx++) {
                expE.get(level).set(0, multiply(expE.get(level - 1).get(idx), expE.get(level).get(0)));
                invE.get(level).set(0, multiply(invE.get(level).get(0), invE.get(level - 1).get(idx)));
            }
            
            for (int idx = 1; idx < k; idx++) {
                Mat temp1 = multiply(expE.get(level).get(idx - 1), invE.get(level - 1).get(idx - 1));
                expE.get(level).set(idx, multiply(expE.get(level - 1).get(idx - 1), temp1));
                
                Mat temp2 = multiply(invE.get(level).get(idx - 1), invE.get(level - 1).get(idx - 1));
                invE.get(level).set(idx, multiply(expE.get(level - 1).get(idx - 1), temp2));
            }
        }
    }

    static Vec recursive_solve(long num, Vec v, int level) {
        if (num == 0) return v;
        int w = digit_sum_mod(num / k);
        v = recursive_solve(num / k, v, level + 1);
        for (int i = 0; i < num % k; i++) {
            v = multiply(expE.get(level).get((w + i) % (int) k), v);
        }
        return v;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextLong();
        k = sc.nextLong();
        
        baseM = new ArrayList<>();
        invM = new ArrayList<>();
        current = new Vec((int) k);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            Mat baseMat = new Mat((int) k);
            Mat invMat = new Mat((int) k);
            for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) {
                for (int l = 0; l < k; l++) {
                    if (j == l) {
                        baseMat.a[j][l] = 1;
                        invMat.a[j][l] = 1;
                    } else if (j == i) {
                        baseMat.a[j][l] = 1;
                        invMat.a[j][l] = -1;
                    } else {
                        baseMat.a[j][l] = 0;
                        invMat.a[j][l] = 0;
                    }
                }
            }
            baseM.add(baseMat);
            invM.add(invMat);
        }
        
        current.a[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < k; i++) {
            current.a[i] = 1;
        }
        
        preprocess();
        current = recursive_solve(n, current, 0);
        
        long total = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            total = (total + current.a[i]) % MOD;
        }
        total = ((total - 1) % MOD + MOD) % MOD;
        
        while (total % (k - 1) != 0) {
            total = (total + MOD) % (MOD * (k - 1));
        }
        
        System.out.println(total / (k - 1));
    }
}
